basics.name: EJ Fox
basics.label: Designer & Developer
basics.summary: Data visualization expert working at the intersection of design, journalism, and data. Experience working with a wide variety of clients and datasets to create work that makes complicated things easy to understand. Focusing on iterating quickly, building toolsets and teams, and telling important stories.

work.summary: Lenfest AI Fellow at ASU, 2025–26. Built a print-layout automation tool.

Worked across NBC News Digital and Broadcast teams to rebuild the “Big Board” application used by Chuck Todd (NBC News) and Steve Kornacki (MSNBC) to call elections on air. Co-built the app and was lead designer, with Michael Small and the NBC News Digital product and technology teams, rebuilding it in D3, Vue, and TopoJSON.

Helped build Vocativ’s visual news team with a focus on data visualization and storytelling. Worked across the newsroom to find, create, analyze, and visualize a wide variety of datasets and stories. Created tools and processes to respond to a fast-paced news cycle with a small team.
